text:
A private venture plans a $1 billion seawater desalination plant on South Padre Island: 50 million gallons a day, roughly 56,000 acre-feet a year. It would be privately owned, with the company setting contracts and prices, and many steps remain before it breaks ground.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auormf6yM2Q

Sources: KRGV; Texas Border Business; MyRGV. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
